senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (फक्कति)
1 To creep, to move slowly or sluggishly.
2 To behave ill, to practise ill or improper conduct.

f. (-का)
1 A position, an assertion or argument, to be proved or maintained.
2 Logical exposition or elucidation.
3 A sophism.
4 A trick.
5 Illusion.
6 Fraud.
E.
फक्क to move slowly, aff. किकन्.
